sections.description: The RYOBI 2-Tool Combo is the perfect solution for woodworking projects. The 18V Compact Router operates between 20,000 - 30,000 RPM, allowing users the ability to trim with enhanced power and accuracy in all applications. Easily change depth of cut with micro and macro depth adjustment. The new ONE+ Cordless Compact Router is 20% more compact (than P601) and the new ergonomic design helps to provide comfort and control during extended use. The 18V 5” Random Orbit Sander features a fast 10,000 orbits per minute (OPM) that will provide a swirl-free finish to each new project. This sander delivers optimized control and comfort while sanding with 40% reduced vibration vs the previous model. Quickly and easily change sandpaper with the easy hook and loop sanding pad base. This 18V ONE+ 2-Tool Combo is backed by the RYOBI 3-Year Manufacturer's Warranty and includes PCL424 18V Compact Router, PCL406 18V 5" Random Orbit Sander, Collet Wrench, Vacuum Dust Chute, (3) Pieces of Sandpaper Assortment, Dust Collection Bag and Operator's Manuals. Battery and charger sold separately.

sections.description: RYOBI 5" Random Orbit Sand Paper is compatible with all 5" random orbit sanders. This set comes with multiple grit options (80 grit/120 grit/220 grit) to help tackle most jobs. The hook and loop backing on each pad allows for quick and convenient changing on and off of the tool. Each pad features pre-cut holes for uniform elimination of dust and wood chips. This set is a great replacement for when it's time to upgrade your previous sanding pad. Ideal for Wood, Metal, Drywall, Fiberglass and painted surfaces.
